product_family: TickTick is a consumer/prosumer to-do list, calendar, and habit-tracking app (web, desktop, mobile) with a Premium subscription tier and a Team/Collaboration feature (shared lists, task assignment); no distinct enterprise/admin-governed tier or API product was found.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. TickTick's Security page (https://ticktick.com/security) describes AWS hosting, encryption at rest, firewalls, and backups, but does not mention SOC 2 anywhere.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on the Security page, Privacy Policy, or Terms of Service, and no trust center exists.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: "When absolutely necessary, TickTick uses third party services and hosting partners who are GDPR-compliant" and the policy commits to breach notification "within 72 hours" of a qualifying incident.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No mention of HIPAA, Business Associate Agreements (BAA), or healthcare-specific handling anywhere on the vendor's Security, Privacy, or Terms pages.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of this certification; not referenced anywhere on the vendor's site.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of this certification; not referenced anywhere on the vendor's site.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Payment details are described only as "stored and encrypted at rest"; no PCI DSS attestation is referenced. Payments are likely processed by a third party (e.g. Stripe, per privacy-policy references), which would carry its own PCI scope rather than TickTick's.

privacy.ai_training_note: The privacy policy explicitly states for AI features: "your data is neither shared with third-party AI providers nor used to train our models." No opt-out is needed since training is stated not to occur at all; no tier-based distinction (free vs Premium) was found in the policy text captured.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly disclosed for general user data. AI features are stated to run on "Amazon Web Services (AWS)" infrastructure "in the United States"; no regional data-residency options (e.g. EU-only storage) are described.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: "User data, including task details, account information and payment details, are all stored and encrypted at rest."

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Not explicitly specified with a protocol name (e.g. TLS version) on the vendor's Security page; the page does not detail transit encryption.

security.name: Infrastructure / hosting
security.value: Hosted on "Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the United States" with "built-in firewalls to protect your data against unauthorized remote access" and "continuous monitoring for potential vulnerabilities."

security.name: Backups
security.value: Data is "automatically backed up on AWS servers with the capability of providing point-in-time recovery."

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Policy states users will be notified within 72 hours after TickTick becomes aware of a qualifying breach likely to create a risk to user rights.

security.name: Data sharing with third parties
security.value: "we will never share your data with third parties without your prior permission" and the policy states personal data will never be sold to third parties.

products.name: TickTick (Free)
products.data_scope: Task data, calendar entries, habit-tracking logs, account info (name, email, device/browser info).
products.notes: Core product; same infrastructure and privacy posture as Premium, feature-gated rather than security-gated.

products.name: TickTick Premium
products.data_scope: Same data scope as Free plus additional storage/attachment limits and advanced features (unlimited calendar subscriptions, folders, etc.).

products.name: TickTick AI features
products.category: AI-assisted task creation / NLP date parsing
products.data_scope: Task text and, per privacy policy, potentially AI interaction text/audio.
products.notes: Vendor explicitly states this data is not shared with third-party AI providers and not used to train models; hosted on AWS.

products.name: TickTick Team / Collaboration
products.category: Shared lists and task assignment for small groups
products.notes: No dedicated enterprise admin console, SSO, or org-wide compliance documentation was found; appears to be a feature within the same consumer product rather than a separate enterprise SKU.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free tier plus paid Premium subscription (and an Education discount); no visible per-seat enterprise pricing.
compare.data_residency: AWS, United States (as stated for AI infrastructure); no explicit region choice or EU-residency option disclosed.

flags: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, ISO 42001, or CSA STAR evidence found anywhere on the vendor's domain - list as startup-tier posture, not a red flag, but do not display any cert badges.

Privacy Policy text fetched shows a 'Last Revision: June 24, 2021' date on one crawled variant, which may be stale relative to the AI-training language found (AI features are newer); recommend a human check that the live policy is current before publishing.

GDPR compliance is described only as a posture via GDPR-compliant subprocessors/partners, not a formal GDPR Article 30 record or DPA document; do not claim 'GDPR certified' since GDPR has no certification scheme.
No HIPAA BAA or healthcare-specific language found; AIFOXX should not list TickTick as suitable for PHI/healthcare use cases.
Encryption in transit (TLS) is not explicitly documented on the vendor's own Security page, only encryption at rest; do not over-claim 'end-to-end encrypted' without vendor confirmation.
